final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, 1.0 * qualifying_count / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS qualifying_share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_city_share FROM city_counts) SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_share, qualifying_share - average_city_share AS share_above_average FROM shares WHERE qualifying_share > average_city_share ORDER BY qualifying_share DESC, city
